phases.title: Evidence-protocol foundation
phases.outcome: Open governance, schemas, claims policy, versioned artifacts, and three known-answer spacetime calibrations.

phases.title: Quiet Compute validation contract
phases.outcome: Machine-validated measurement, deliberate-submission, matched comparison, guardrail, replication, consensus, and adversarial contracts exist; external domain review and preregistration remain open.

phases.title: Controlled acoustic and thermal baseline
phases.outcome: Publish repeated raw sound, spectrum, workload, temperature, energy, water, equipment, and environment traces for one declared system.

phases.title: Independent baseline reproduction
phases.outcome: A separate operator and environment recover the frozen baseline within preregistered tolerances and disclose conflicts of interest.

phases.title: One bounded intervention
phases.outcome: Test one control, airflow, liquid-cooling, power, or thermal-material change without failing workload, thermal, energy, water, reliability, or cost guardrails.

phases.title: Secure federated runner
phases.outcome: Signed admission, immutable-runtime and quota filters, atomic replay claims, diversity allocation, tolerance consensus, and isolation-plan generation exist. Execution remains disabled pending an independently reviewed sandbox adapter.

phases.title: Partner-led design and materials search
phases.outcome: Expand to accelerated simulation, design search, and long-horizon materials hypotheses only after validated baselines, domain review, and physical-test partners exist.
